mounting.contact: custom plate transfers bridge case to large sink base; broad independent clamp
mounting.support: chassis-supported sink and plenum; no heatsink load through bridge leads
mounting.isolation: insulated plate/fasteners and mains creepage require safety review

shared_heat_load_screen.interpretation: This distributed-load screen assumes the catalog Rsa applies at 105W and the bridge receives only its own Rcs/Rjc rise. It is not a system prediction; CFD or measurement must prove local spreading, airflow and heat partition.

limitations: two 41 CFM free-air fans provide at most 82 CFM before pressure losses
shared load includes provisional 65 W allowance
system CFD or measurement must resolve heat distribution and recirculation
